station_source: NOAA/NCEI Integrated Surface Database (ISD) station history
selection_rules: Use only station-history records with BEGIN <= configured start date and END >= configured end date.
Require non-null latitude/longitude in valid geographic bounds; reject the 0,0 placeholder.
For each airport represented in prepared flights, select the nearest valid station within 75.0 km using haversine distance (Earth radius 6371.0088 km).
Break equal-distance ties by station_id ascending.
availability_score: omitted: no NOAA observation availability was downloaded or computed
